chinese: 我他妈的才不管你们说什么！
pinyin: wǒ tā mā de cái bù guǎn nǐ men shuō shén me!
english: I don't give a fuck about what you say!

pinyin: ràng wǒ kàn kan nèi xiē zhào piān.
english: Let me have a look at those photos.

chinese: 我有一些非常好的消息。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu yī xiē fēi cháng hǎo de xiāo xi.
english: I have some very good news.

pinyin: nǐ yī zhǔn bèi hǎo, wǒ men jiù zǒu.
english: We'll leave as soon as you're ready.

chinese: 我凭什么花时间做这事？
pinyin: wǒ píng shén me huā shí jiān zuò zhè shì?
english: Why should I take the time to do that?

pinyin: zhè bù shì wǒ de rì běn péng you.
english: This is not my Japanese friend.

pinyin: nǐ yào shāng hài tā ma?
english: Are you going to hurt her?

pinyin: qù nián tā lí kāi le rì běn.
english: Last year she left Japan.

pinyin: nǐ zǒu de hǎo kuài ā!
english: How fast you walk!

pinyin: tā hěn kuài jiù zhǎng wò le é yǔ.
english: He acquired Russian quickly.

pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān de xīn qíng bù hǎo.
english: I'm feeling blue today.

chinese: 你想要哪种风格的家具？
pinyin: nǐ xiǎng yào nǎ zhǒng fēng gé de jiā jù?
english: What style of furniture would you like?

pinyin: nǐ zhí xíng nǐ de jì huà le ma?
english: Did you carry out your plan?

pinyin: nǐ pèng jiàn guo tā le ma?
english: Did you meet her?

chinese: 你要看一部法国片，是吗？
pinyin: nǐ yào kàn yī bù fǎ guó piàn, shì ma?
english: You want to watch a French film, is that right?

chinese: 我想你用自己的想象力。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng nǐ yòng zì jǐ de xiǎng xiàng lì.
english: I want you to use your imagination.

chinese: 如果這是真的，那就太好了。
pinyin: rú guǒ zhè shì zhēn de, nà jiù tài hǎo le.
english: It would be great if that were true.

chinese: 她问了我们好几个问题。
pinyin: tā wèn le wǒ men hǎo jǐ gè wèn tí.
english: She asked us several questions.

chinese: 我为你的成功感到高兴。
pinyin: wǒ wèi nǐ de chéng gōng gǎn dào gāo xìng.
english: I rejoice in your success.

chinese: 我没有特别的理由去做。
pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu tè bié de lǐ yóu qù zuò.
english: I have no particular reason to do so.

pinyin: nǐ néng yuán liàng wǒ ma?
english: Could you forgive me?

pinyin: tā de yīn yuè huì fēi cháng hǎo.
english: His concert was great.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kàn kan.
english: I want to have a little look.

chinese: 您是新来的秘书吧，不是吗？
pinyin: nín shì xīn lái de mì shū ba, bù shì ma?
english: You're the new secretary, aren't you?

chinese: 你认为他适合这个职位吗？
pinyin: nǐ rèn wéi tā shì hé zhè ge zhí wèi ma?
english: Do you think he is good for the position?

chinese: 你喜欢棒球到什么程度？
pinyin: nǐ xǐ huan bàng qiú dào shén me chéng dù?
english: To what degree are you interested in baseball?

chinese: 成千上万的人想要知道答案。
pinyin: chéng qiān shàng wàn de rén xiǎng yào zhī dào dá àn.
english: Thousands of people wanted to know the answer.

pinyin: tā qù le mǒu gè dì fang.
english: He went to some place or other.

chinese: 她认为计划很好，但不可行。
pinyin: tā rèn wéi jì huà hěn hǎo, dàn bù kě xíng.
english: She thought the plan was fine but impractical.

pinyin: qīng xīn de rén yǒu fú le.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart.

chinese: 她上飞机前，给我招了招手。
pinyin: tā shàng fēi jī qián, gěi wǒ zhāo le zhāo shǒu.
english: She waved at me before she got on board the plane.

chinese: 旅行最快的方式是乘飞机。
pinyin: lǚ xíng zuì kuài de fāng shì shì chéng fēi jī.
english: The fastest way to travel is by plane.

chinese: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。
pinyin: nǐ kǎo lǜ zhōu dào, méi yǒu dǎ rǎo wǒ men.
english: You were considerate not to disturb us.

pinyin: yī shēng, qǐng gěi zhè hái zi jí jiù.
english: Doctor, please give this child first aid.

pinyin: xī yān yǐng xiǎng le tā de fèi bù.
english: Smoking has affected his lungs.

pinyin: wǒ qù gōng yuán sàn le bù.
english: I went for a walk in the park.

chinese: 还轮到他们来教我做事了？
pinyin: hái lún dào tā men lái jiāo wǒ zuò shì le?
english: Who are they to tell me what to do?

pinyin: tā shì shén me shí hou jiàn chéng de?
english: When was it built?

pinyin: yǒu de dì fang bù néng lǐ jiě.
english: Some parts are hard to understand.

chinese: 事故耽误了我们半小时。
pinyin: shì gù dān wu le wǒ men bàn xiǎo shí.
english: An accident delayed us for half an hour.

chinese: 我注册了，现在该干什么呢？
pinyin: wǒ zhù cè le, xiàn zài gāi gàn shén me ne?
english: What do I have to do now that I'm registered?

pinyin: wǒ lǐ jiě nǐ suǒ shuō de yī qiè.
english: I understand everything you said.

pinyin: nǐ běn bù gāi bǎ rén mài le de.
english: You shouldn't have sold this to someone.

chinese: 我的兄弟被捕了而不是他。
pinyin: wǒ de xiōng dì bèi bǔ le ér bù shì tā.
english: My brother was arrested, not him.

chinese: 你会很惊讶你在一周内能学到的东西。
pinyin: nǐ huì hěn jīng yà nǐ zài yī zhōu nèi néng xué dào de dōng xi.
english: You'd be surprised what you can learn in a week.

chinese: 这张照片让我想起童年的快乐时光。
pinyin: zhè zhāng zhào piàn ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ tóng nián de kuài lè shí guāng.
english: This photograph reminds me of enjoyable times when I was a child.

pinyin: wǒ men zhōng de yī gè de zǒu.
english: One of us has to go.

chinese: 除了真相，我什么都不说。
pinyin: chú le zhēn xiàng, wǒ shén me dōu bù shuō.
english: I speak nothing but the truth.

pinyin: tā shì wǒ suǒ kě wàng de nǚ rén.
english: She is the woman of my desires.

pinyin: zhè jiù shì tā suǒ shuō de.
english: That's exactly what he said.

pinyin: nǐ yào yòng zhè liàng chē gàn má?
english: What are you going to use this car for?

pinyin: nǐ shàng le jǐ suǒ xué xiào?
english: How many different schools have you attended?

pinyin: wǒ zài zhè dāi yī huì.
english: I'll stay here for a bit.

chinese: 我不了解他所說的事情。
pinyin: wǒ bu liǎo jiě tā suǒ shuō de shì qing.
english: I couldn't understand anything that he said.

pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huan bēi shāng de diàn yǐng.
english: I don't like sad movies.

chinese: 您能看到那栋小房子吗？
pinyin: nín néng kàn dào nà dòng xiǎo fáng zi ma?
english: Can you see that small house?

pinyin: wǒ méi xiǎng tōu tīng de.
english: I didn't mean to eavesdrop.

pinyin: tā dǎ duàn le wǒ men de tán lùn.
english: He interrupted our discussion.

chinese: 你必须从失败中吸取教训。
pinyin: nǐ bì xū cóng shī bài zhōng xī qǔ jiào xun.
english: You must learn from mistakes.

pinyin: hēi, nǐ de gǒu gāng yǎo le wǒ.
english: Hey, your dog just bit me.

chinese: 我不明白他为何搞这样。
pinyin: wǒ bù míng bai tā wèi hé gǎo zhè yàng.
english: I have no idea why he did that.

chinese: 现在的猫都不吃老鼠了。
pinyin: xiàn zài de māo dōu bù chī lǎo shǔ le.
english: Cats don't eat mice these days.

pinyin: nǐ de shǒu bì téng ma?
english: Does your arm hurt?

pinyin: nǐ bù yīng gāi dài zài zhè lǐ.
english: You're not supposed to be in this area.

chinese: 请把他所说的记录下来。
pinyin: qǐng bǎ tā suǒ shuō de jì lù xià lai.
english: Please write down what he says.

chinese: 我从来没有相信过战争是好的。
pinyin: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu xiāng xìn guo zhàn zhēng shì hǎo de.
english: I've never believed that war is good.

pinyin: nǐ huì dài duō cháng shí jiān?
english: How long will you be staying?

pinyin: tā shì zhè ge guó jiā de zǒng lǐ.
english: He is the prime minister of this country.

pinyin: tā gěi tā zuò le gè àn mó.
english: She gave him a massage.

pinyin: nǐ bù dǒng de cí zuò ge jì hao.
english: Mark the words that you cannot understand.

chinese: 我在找這把吉他的主人。
pinyin: wǒ zài zhǎo zhè bǎ jí tā de zhǔ rén.
english: I'm trying to find the person who owns this guitar.

chinese: 我厌烦了他的长篇大论。
pinyin: wǒ yàn fán le tā de cháng piān dà lùn.
english: I got bored with his long talk.

pinyin: wǒ zuó tiān bèi jiě gù le.
english: I was fired yesterday.

chinese: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
pinyin: chūn tiān hé qiū tiān, nǐ gèng xǐ huan něi ge?
english: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?

chinese: 除了胡萝卜，他没有什么是不吃的。
pinyin: chú le hú luó bo, tā méi yǒu shén me shì bù chī de.
english: Except for carrots, there is nothing he won't eat.

pinyin: dàn yuàn shì zhè yàng ba.
english: Let's hope so.

chinese: 他是日本最伟大的艺术家之一。
pinyin: tā shì rì běn zuì wěi dà de yì shù jiā zhī yī.
english: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.

pinyin: zhè shì jiǎn tǐ zì.
english: This is simplified Chinese.

chinese: 我想和你一起去音乐会。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yī qǐ qù yīn yuè huì.
english: I would like to go to the concert with you.

chinese: 我一有空就給你打電話。
pinyin: wǒ yī yǒu kòng jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà.
english: I'll call you as soon as I'm free.

pinyin: tā dǎ wǎng qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
english: He plays tennis very well.

pinyin: tā jiǎ zhuāng shì xué sheng.
english: She pretended to be a student.

pinyin: zhè shì yī gè yú chǔn de wèn tí.
english: That's a dumb question.

pinyin: duì bu qǐ, shì wǒ gū fù nǐ le.
english: I am sorry for disappointing you.

chinese: 我和她在中学是一个班的。
pinyin: wǒ hé tā zài zhōng xué shì yī gè bān de.
english: She and I were in the same class in middle school.

chinese: 她不知道该和他说些什么。
pinyin: tā bù zhī dào gāi hé tā shuō xiē shén me.
english: She didn't know what to say to him.

pinyin: wèi shén me zōng jiào shì bì yào de?
english: Why is religion necessary?

pinyin: nǐ hé tā shì péng you ma?
english: Are you friends with him?

chinese: 你的書真是多到可怕啊!
pinyin: nǐ de shū zhēn shi duō dào kě pà ā!
english: What an awful lot of books you have!

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ yī qǐ zǒu.
english: I want to go with you.

chinese: 她和他共住在一間很小的公寓裡。
pinyin: tā hé tā gòng zhù zài yī jiān hěn xiǎo de gōng yù lǐ.
english: She lives with him in a small apartment.

pinyin: wǒ zhī dào shēng mìng shì duǎn zàn de.
english: I know life is short.

pinyin: zhè shì shén me fèi huà?
english: What is this nonsense?

chinese: 我听说了你有美丽的口音。
pinyin: wǒ tīng shuō le nǐ yǒu měi lì de kǒu yīn.
english: I heard you have a beautiful voice.

chinese: 喂，小鬼！这里是我们的地盘！
pinyin: wèi, xiǎo guǐ! zhè lǐ shì wǒ men de dì pán!
english: Hey, twirp! This here is our territory!

chinese: 他们指责我没有信守诺言。
pinyin: tā men zhǐ zé wǒ méi yǒu xìn shǒu nuò yán.
english: They accused me of having broken my promise.

chinese: 这个国家的政府压迫人民。
pinyin: zhè ge guó jiā de zhèng fǔ yā pò rén mín.
english: The government of this country oppresses its people.

chinese: 一个绅士是不会做这种事的。
pinyin: yī gè shēn shì shì bù huì zuò zhè zhǒng shì de.
english: A gentleman wouldn't do such a thing.

chinese: 是你提议去看这个电影的。
pinyin: shì nǐ tí yì qù kàn zhè ge diàn yǐng de.
english: It was you that suggested seeing that movie.

pinyin: wǒ néng hé nǐ tán tán ma?
english: May I have a talk with you?

pinyin: é... zhè ge shì zěn me yùn zuò de?
english: Uh...how does this work?

chinese: 你为什么要和经理争论？
pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me yào hé jīng lǐ zhēng lùn?
english: Why are you arguing with the manager?

pinyin: tā gěi le wǒ shí wù hé qián.
english: He gave me food and money as well.

chinese: 在这点上他泄露了秘密。
pinyin: zài zhè diǎn shàng tā xiè lù le mì mì.
english: He let out the secret regarding this matter.

chinese: 你相信他真是太愚蠢了。
pinyin: nǐ xiāng xìn tā zhēn shi tài yú chǔn le.
english: It is stupid of you to believe in him.

pinyin: wǒ de xìng qù bèi jī qǐ lái le.
english: My interest quickened.

pinyin: tā de yī shēng jiàn yì tā jiè yān.
english: His doctor advised him to quit smoking.

pinyin: wǒ hé nǐ bǎo zhèng.
english: I gave you my word.
